doc: Task 12: behind the front the Lisp backend writes coordination tables only through the front (drgnx-coord-writer front). job/propose is 3 front writes (coord/job-create, messages/send and coord/card-create for the proposal card) and job/stop 3 more (cards/settle, messages/mark, coord/job-set); the front's status.store.writes counts them, and work.db has the job, its tasks and the job event. A local write in the backend would have signalled and failed the call, and would not count.
